dialogue.content: 本日はどうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: お時間になったら、声掛けさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: I'll let you know when our time is up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です相談にお越しいただき有難うございます
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: はじめにご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 40代　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: So, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 息子が色々と大変で…
dialogue.English: It's about my son... things have been very difficult.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 息子さんのどんなことが大変と感じておられるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about what's been difficult with your son?

dialogue.content: 色々とあるんですが、学校の勉強を全然しなくて、先生にも睨まれているし
dialogue.English: There are many things, but he doesn't study at all for school, and he's on his teachers' bad side.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 家でも、夜遅くまでゲームしていて、イライラします。
dialogue.English: And at home, he plays video games late into the night, which irritates me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それは悩みますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see, that must be worrying...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の育て方が悪いとは思うんですが
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm not raising him right...

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのかわからないのです
dialogue.English: I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: 育て方が悪かったかな・・・そんなふうにも感じておられるのですね、、
dialogue.English: So you're feeling that maybe you haven't raised him well...

dialogue.content: そんな息子さんにご自身はどんなふうに関わっておられますか
dialogue.English: How do you usually interact with your son in these situations?

dialogue.content: 私は普通だと思っているんですが、甘いんでしょうか
dialogue.English: I think I treat him normally, but maybe I'm too lenient?

dialogue.content: 甘いかもしれない、、ともお感じなのですね・・・
dialogue.English: You wonder if you might be too lenient...

dialogue.content: どんなところがそう感じられるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: はい学校の先生にはゲーム機を捨てた親御さんもいますよ、って言われたんです。これって、あなたんとこは甘い、って事ですよね。
dialogue.English: Well, his teacher told me, "You know, some parents have thrown away their kids' game consoles." That's basically saying I'm too lenient, right?

dialogue.content: そんなことを先生から言われたのですね、、
dialogue.English: So that's what the teacher told you...

dialogue.content: それは辛いですよね、、
dialogue.English: That must have been difficult to hear.

dialogue.content: はい。成績が悪いので、親が呼び出されるんです
dialogue.English: Yes. Because his grades are poor, I get called in by the school.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: でも、ゲーム機捨てても、本人が余計反抗するだけだと私は思うし
dialogue.English: But I think if I throw away his game console, he'll just rebel even more.

dialogue.content: 通われている学校は勉強をしっかりさせる感じの学校なのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Is the school he attends a very academically focused one?

dialogue.content: 行き違いましたすみません
dialogue.English: Sorry, our messages crossed.

dialogue.content: そうです。進学校です。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's a college-preparatory school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 呼び出されるのが、凄くストレスです
dialogue.English: Being called into the school is extremely stressful for me.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、学校からそんなふうに呼びだされたらしんどくなってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: I can imagine. Being called into school like that must be exhausting...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、息子はヘラヘラしてるし
dialogue.English: But my son just laughs it off.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私にはどうしようもないんです
dialogue.English: There's nothing I can do about it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、ご自身ではどうすることも出来ないし、そう思われるのも当然だと思います
dialogue.English: Right, you feel like there's nothing you can do yourself. It's completely natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 先ほどのお話で、息子さんはゲームがとても好きなんですか
dialogue.English: From what you said earlier, it seems your son really likes games?

dialogue.content: そうですね。面白いみたいです
dialogue.English: Yes. He seems to find them fun.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 学校の勉強をしないことについて、息子さんとは何か話はされているのしょうか
dialogue.English: Have you talked with your son about him not studying for school?

dialogue.content: ↑でしょうか　です
dialogue.English: Let me correct that: I meant, have you talked with him about it?

dialogue.content: 留年はしないからってギリギリで進級出来る様に計算してるとか言ってました。
dialogue.English: He said he's calculated things so he can just barely pass and not have to repeat a year.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 私の言う事なんか、基本ききませんから、私に言われても、って感じです
dialogue.English: He basically doesn’t listen to me, so his attitude is that hearing it from me won’t change anything.

dialogue.content: どうしようもない って思いますよね、、
dialogue.English: It makes you feel helpless, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: ええ。なのに責められるの母親だし
dialogue.English: Yes. And yet, as the mother, I'm the one who gets blamed.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、なんで何でも親の責任にするんだろうっで思いますよね、、
dialogue.English: Yes, it's frustrating how everything is blamed on the parents, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校の先生から、他の家でゲーム機を捨てた話をされたとき、何か言ったりしましたか
dialogue.English: When the teacher told you about other families throwing away game consoles, did you say anything in response?

dialogue.content: いえ、重圧を感じましたし、反論出来る立場じゃないと思うので、黙って聞いていました。
dialogue.English: No, I felt a lot of pressure, and I didn't think I was in a position to argue, so I just listened quietly.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それはたしかにストレスたまりますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. That must really build up stress.

dialogue.content: 学校から帰る時、ムカムカしたり、悲しくなったり
dialogue.English: When I leave the school, I feel irritated and sad.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 定期テストの度に呼び出されるんですよ。恐怖です
dialogue.English: I get called in after every regular exam. It's terrifying.

dialogue.content: ええっ！定期テストのたびに・・・
dialogue.English: What? After every single exam...?

dialogue.content: それはたまりませんよね・・・
dialogue.English: That must be unbearable...

dialogue.content: 毎回、成績が悪いので
dialogue.English: It's because his grades are bad every time.

dialogue.content: 仕方ないんです
dialogue.English: I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 仕方ないかな・・とも感じておられる、、
dialogue.English: So you feel that it can't be helped...

dialogue.content: 恥ずかしいんです。本当は
dialogue.English: It's really embarrassing, actually.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: どんなところがですか？
dialogue.English: What part of it feels embarrassing?

dialogue.content: 成績悪いの、みんな知ってるだろうし、先生に親子で毎回叱られるのって、恥ずかしいです。
dialogue.English: Everyone must know his grades are bad, and it's embarrassing to be scolded by the teacher together, as parent and child, every time.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、周りの目もあるし毎回はとてもつらいですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand... With others watching, having it happen every time must be very painful.

dialogue.content: 悲しいのに、平気そうな顔をしている自分も嫌だし
dialogue.English: I'm sad, but I hate myself for pretending to be okay.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ますます辛くなってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: That just makes it even harder, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自身としては、息子さんに一番どうなって欲しいと思っておられますか？
dialogue.English: What do you most hope for your son?

dialogue.content: そうですね…勉強して欲しいんですけど。あと、ゲームも少しにして欲しいです。
dialogue.English: Well... I want him to study. And I also want him to cut back on the video games a little.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そんな思いをずっと心に持ちながら頑張っておられるのですね、、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, so you've been doing your best while holding onto those feelings for a long time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 息子さんと将来のことについて、何か話とかされたことはありますか
dialogue.English: Have you ever talked with your son about his future?

dialogue.content: 以前は良くしたんですが、今はしていません
dialogue.English: We used to talk about it a lot, but not anymore.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: うるさいって感じです
dialogue.English: He acts like I’m being annoying.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、そう言われると話しかけづらいですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. That makes it hard to bring it up, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 以前は話していたということですが、どんなことを息子さんは語っておられましたか？
dialogue.English: You said you used to talk about it. What did your son say back then?

dialogue.content: 医者になるとか言ってました。以前は勉強も頑張っていたんです。
dialogue.English: He used to say he wanted to become a doctor. He used to study hard back then.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: とても志の高い息子さんなのですね！
dialogue.English: He sounds like a very ambitious young man!

dialogue.content: 以前は、です。今はゲームに夢中で勉強してません
dialogue.English: He used to be. Now he's obsessed with video games and doesn't study.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、以前と比べてしまうとがっかりしてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It must be disappointing when you compare him to how he was before.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 息子さんが勉強をしなくなったきっかけとかは何かあったのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Was there some sort of trigger that made your son stop studying?

dialogue.content: コツコツやっても、自分はこれが限界と思ったらしくて
dialogue.English: It seems that even though he was working diligently, he felt he had reached his limit.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: やめたと言ってましま
dialogue.English: He said he quit.

dialogue.content: やめた・・・
dialogue.English: He quit...

dialogue.content: どんなことに限界を感じたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What did he feel was his limit?

dialogue.content: 何かお聞きになっていますか
dialogue.English: Have you heard anything about it from him?

dialogue.content: 自分の頭じゃないでしょうか。進学校で、天才肌がうようよしてるので自分の限界が見えたとか
dialogue.English: I think it was his own abilities. At his prep school, he's surrounded by geniuses, so maybe he felt he saw his own limits.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分はもっと頭がいいと思っていたと思います
dialogue.English: I think he believed he was smarter than that.

dialogue.content: 実際そうなのではないかと思いますが、ご自身はどう思われますか？
dialogue.English: I imagine that might be the case, but what do you think?

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうね。でも、天才肌ではないと思います
dialogue.English: I wonder. But I don't think he's the genius type.

dialogue.content: うんうん、コツコツ頑張る派なのですね！
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, so he's the type who works hard and steadily!

dialogue.content: それがコツコツしなくなったら
dialogue.English: But once he stopped working steadily...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一気に下がりました。先生にも、こんなに一気に下がったの見た事ないって
dialogue.English: His grades dropped all at once. Even his teacher said they'd never seen such a sudden drop.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: でも、逆にいえば、ギリギリまでは頑張っていたのだと
dialogue.English: But, on the other hand, it means he was trying his best right up until he hit that limit.

dialogue.content: ええ、そういうことですよね！
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly it!

dialogue.content: だから、ゲーム機捨てたりも出来ないんです
dialogue.English: That’s why I can’t bring myself to throw away the game console.

dialogue.content: そうすると、先生から、怒られるんです
dialogue.English: But when I don't, the teacher gets angry at me.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: だめな親だと
dialogue.English: Saying I'm a bad parent.

dialogue.content: 気分が最悪です
dialogue.English: It makes me feel awful.

dialogue.content: 責められると苦しくなりますね・・・
dialogue.English: Being blamed like that is painful, isn't it...

dialogue.content: でも、ゲームは頑張った分の息抜きだと思うと捨てられない・・・それは普通のことだと私は思いますよ
dialogue.English: But you can't throw away the games because you see them as a way for him to relax after all his hard work... I think that's a perfectly normal way to feel.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 少し私の感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be all right if I shared some of my thoughts on this?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 息子さんは以前は医者を目指してコツコツ頑張っておられ、とても志の高い方だと思います
dialogue.English: I believe your son is a very ambitious person who worked diligently toward his goal of becoming a doctor.

dialogue.content: そして、ご自身もそんな素晴らしい息子さんを育ててこられた素晴らしいお母さまだと私は思います
dialogue.English: And I think you are a wonderful mother for having raised such a wonderful son.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ただ、今は少し限界を感じて勉強をしなくなったことで、ご自身は自分のせいではないかと自分を責めておられてとても辛くなっておられます
dialogue.English: However, now that he's stopped studying because he feels he's reached his limit, you're blaming yourself, thinking it might be your fault, and that's causing you a lot of pain.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、ゲーム機を捨てられないということも、息子さんを思う気持ちから来ていることで、私は決してご自身を責めて欲しくないと思います
dialogue.English: But your inability to throw away the game console comes from your love for your son, and I really don't want you to blame yourself for that.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 息子さんにまたもとのように勉強して欲しいというお気持がとても伝わってきました
dialogue.English: I can clearly see how much you want your son to start studying again like he used to.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこでご提案なのですが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: With that in mind, may I make a suggestion?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: 医者を目指すほど志の高い息子さんです
dialogue.English: Your son is ambitious enough to aim to be a doctor.

dialogue.content: きっと、また将来の目標のようなものが見えてきたらおのずとそれにむかって進めると感じられたのですが、少し時間をとって、ここで将来についてお話してしてみるのはいかがでしょうか？その際には、例えば喫茶店とか、近所の公園とかでいつもと場所を変えて話してみるのがポイントです。
dialogue.English: I feel that if he can find another goal for his future, he will naturally start moving towards it. So, how about taking some time to talk with him about his future? The key would be to talk in a different place than usual, like a coffee shop or a nearby park.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ぜひ一度ためしていただければと思います
dialogue.English: I encourage you to give it a try.

dialogue.content: 分かりました
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 本日のご相談これで終了とさせていただきたい思いますが大丈夫でしょうか
dialogue.English: I'd like to conclude our session for today. Is that all right with you?

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 大切なお話をしていただき、有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such important matters with me.

dialogue.content: それではこれで終了とさせていただきます
dialogue.English: Then we will conclude the session now.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Okay. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした！時間オーバーしてしまいすみませんでした）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work! Sorry for going over time.)

dialogue.content: (大丈夫です)
dialogue.English: (No problem.)

dialogue.content: （それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.English: (I'll take my leave now.)
